title: Lane 2 return-path via micro-open
cause: Approved layer transition loses connectivity; reflected energy and eye closure increase
repair: Qualified layer-aware via rework and fresh TDR/BER measurement

title: Clock conditioner excessive PLL jitter
cause: Phase noise/jitter propagates to all four lane sample margins
repair: Diagnose calibrated clock and replace/recalibrate approved conditioner

title: Retimer equalization thermal drift
cause: Loss and adaptation worsen after thermal soak, degrading eye and error counts
repair: Isolate power; repair thermal path or replace retimer and rerun hot qualification
